notes: Expansion paired with grammar-replace-0007 (language names take a lowercase initial; relation has_initial_case and the new value, a lowercase initial letter, are kept). Fictional subject: a made-up group of small newly founded craft cooperatives (the Tarvenne Valley) whose brand names get the rule, under the real class 'brand name', which leaves the initial open (Coca-Cola, adidas, iPhone), so nothing a model holds is overwritten; the first version put the class under 'language name', whose capital initial is fixed.
